source: Local Vite production preview on commit 8c3d44445e75df1b078f0c7abc3be672eaa40469
method: Headed Chrome with the frontmost visible page; Native OS viewport and DPR in a 1440×900 Chrome window. VSync kept on. Measured timestamps of rAF callbacks that issue actual scene draws. Per-frame WebGL2 EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 duration wraps the real render callback. Rejected disjoint queries. Each shot sampled for 5.5 s after camera easing. Separate temporary user-data directories; no browser or system settings outside them were modified.
